newsitem.title: USA: Paradigm to sell wafer plant for $20 mln.
newsitem.headline: Paradigm to sell wafer plant for $20 mln.

text.p: Paradigm Technology Inc Monday said it signed a definitive agreement to sell its wafer-fabrication facility in San Jose to an unnamed company for $20 million.
The transaction price consists of $6.6 million in cash, $7.6 million in debt assumption and a short-term note for $5.8 million.
In a statement, the company said the agreement provides for the buyer to supply a specified quantity of wafers to Paradigm during the next six months.
Completion of the deal is subject to third party consents and approval of the buyer's board of directors.
